synthesis.answer: Partly. You can start component tests of the credit-request logic now, by POSTing order/new directly. End-to-end testing through Magento is not possible yet. I applied every user decision up to DU20 and re-checked the code (branch SpExportaEcommerce, HEAD 2cf425f plus the uncommitted 2026-10-01 edits, +109/-64). On that basis 119 of the vault's 160 LAN rules behave like LAN or differ only by a user decision (74 %). By group: eligibility 18/25, header 36/40, phone validation 17/23, lines 31/40, after the request 17/32. The vault says 86/160 (54 %) because it counts about 25 rules as open while they wait for a confirmation (P12, P16, P17, P9, Q22, P1 G-d), and its rule tables never absorbed DU14-DU17. On that stricter basis the code reaches about 94/160 (59 %). The 41 open rules are 19 decisions (mostly the P1 'no row' gates), 5 differences (the reprocess tool, the R1 Trim, callback keys and transport) and 17 waiting on other teams (liberador DU11, TELEFONIA Q17, SAP OData DU20). The share build bin\ServicioSap.dll (2026-10-02 10:15) contains the current code. Before a positive test, you need to confirm the served instance, pick a test BP, check SIGMavi CondicionesCredVtaLinea.Condicion (Q6), and check the Android login's INSERT permission. If Q6 or the permission fails, ServicioSAP writes a header with no product lines and still answers 'Concluido'. Phone-validation and getSms tests also need TEL-1 settled: the share copy of A_GET_TelefonoValidado returns the newest phone of any type, with undated phones first, not LAN's newest validated mobile. Business Rules Ecommerce matches the code; MATRIZ, CREDITO_WEB_ANALISIS and ACTIVIDADES are stale in the places listed below.

readiness.verdict: PARTIAL. Component tests of request creation (header and lines via a direct POST order/new) can start after user-run prerequisites. Phone-branch and getSms tests also need TEL-1 and NIP-1. Liberador, callback, status, rename and Magento end-to-end are not testable. There is no runtime evidence yet: Logs/sap.log was last written 2026-09-17 and has no credit entries.
ready_now: L0 Build: the current source compiles. Share bin\ServicioSap.dll (2026-10-02 10:15:08) contains the 10-01 literals ('sin condicion de pago', '[CREDITO SD29 FILTRO]', '[ORDER ObtenerNumeroSms ERROR]', ObtenerPreciosCreditoAsync) and none of the removed ones ('Los invitados no pueden', '[CREDITO SIN CUENTA]'). Do not use the X: build of 09-26.
L1 Serve that build (you, VS or IIS Express https://localhost:44399/) and get a JWT. Confirm with a fresh line in Logs\sap.log.

L2 Read-only captures and SELECTs (you run them): BP05/BP05MA of the test BP, SD29 by Articulo+OrgVtas+Condicion, A_GET_TelefonoValidado, the Q6 SIGMavi SELECT, the ServicioAndroid permission and column-type queries.
L3 Contract checks: no token gives 401 ([Authorize] OC:12); a null body gives 400 (OC:20-23, same as LAN); getCondicion/{store}/{cond}.
ready_after: L4 Negatives N1-N3 (cuenta '', '0000000000', 'C00000000') expect 200 'Error, Error en SetOrder: sin cuenta', 0 rows, and only [ORDER NEW ERROR] in sap.log. Run them only after one SAP smoke GET passes, because a SAP outage also gives 'sin cuenta' (OM:730-734).

L4 Negatives N4-N6 need your go-ahead to write to ServicioAndroid and corrected expected values (ACT-04). N4, an unknown condition with costoEnvio 150, gives header + SEGU00001 only (Orden 2, qty 1, price 150, Abono 12, costo NULL) and 'Concluido'. N6, a null condition, gives a header with condicion NULL, 0 lines and [CREDITO ARTICULOS ERROR].

L5 Positives V2 (MA), V2b (VIU with shipping), V2c (SKU with '+') need: a test BP (exists in client 110, not Prospecto, no validated phone, Gender and Birthdt filled); the Q6 SELECT; an SD29 capture for the SKUs; the MAVICBOSANDROID INSERT permission on VTASdArtCreditoWeb; a write go-ahead with a DBA cleanup owner (it is the same DB LAN uses); expected values with nombre = NameFirst+Namemiddle, costo NULL and the R4/P12-A body. Avoid TELEFONIA SKUs and '05 ... P DIF'.

L6 The validated-phone branch needs TEL-1 resolved (paste a real A_GET_TelefonoValidado response), the R2-V captures, and a BP whose newest dated phone is a validated 10-digit mobile with a ZappOrig in the 23-value catalog, plus an SMS row.

L7 NIP SMS: validateSms, and getSms with an unknown BP and cliente '0', can run after L1. Positive getSms sends a real SMS, so it needs your go-ahead, the widths of the Cliente column in both SMS tables, and confirmation that the dispatcher accepts BP-keyed rows. Use cliente '0' until NIP-1 is decided.
L8 Cash regression (E5 escaping, Marst '1') needs your go-ahead to create a BP and an order in SAP DEV.
not_possible: L9 Liberador and Magento callback. The liberador is under construction by the other team (DU11). The callback sends {entity_id, customer_account, credit_request_id}, while the DMZ expects {entityId, cuenta, idSolicitud} (DMZ CreditRequest.cs:212-218). The commented block OM:677-711 does not compile (it uses idClienteMagento and await inside a non-async lambda).

L10 creditStatus, updateCreditOrderId, the post-authorization resend without a duplicate, and Magento end-to-end (V4). No routes exist in ServicioSAP; the DMZ calls URL_INTELISIS; the SAP OData for ZIdEcommerce is pending (DU20). Magento still sends getCuentaIntelisis() (OrderManagement.php:719), so real orders end in 'sin cuenta' while Magento shows PROCESANDO. The checkout gate GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName is not ported, and the DMZ still routes getSms/validateSms to LAN.

bugs.summary: CallMagentoAuthorizationCallbackAsync sends {entity_id, status, customer_account, credit_request_id}. The DMZ CreditAuthorizationRequest (DMZ Models/CreditRequest.cs:212-218) and Magento expect {entityId, status, cuenta, idSolicitud}, so with T1b on and no T1a, Magento gets quote 0, the DMZ answers 500 and the row stays PENDIENTE forever. Spot-checked in both files.

bugs.severity: high if confirmed (depends on Q6 data)
bugs.summary: GetCondicionAsync returns SIGMavi CondicionesCredVtaLinea.Condicion as the SD29 code with no check. If that column holds the Magento text or a Propre description, every credit product line is silently skipped (OM:930-937), only SEGU00001 is written, and the answer is still 'Concluido'. Supporting hint: GetPlazosAsync translates CondicionPropre from the same table through PaymentConditionCatalog (Methods/Credit/CreditMethods.cs:28-45).

bugs.severity: high for parity (external dependency, share copy; the deployed version is NO EVIDENCE)
bugs.summary: max() over all CteTelSet phones by (Zfecha, ZfechaCap, ZidcteTel), with no MOVIL or Zvaltel filter. Null dates are defaulted to '00000000' (AS_GET_ZQBP_EditarCliente_CteTel.py:61-62), which sorts above '/Date(...)/', so an undated unvalidated phone wins. ServicioSAP then sees no validated phone (SCW:517-519), which changes ValidacionTelefono and LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar, and getSms answers 0 with no SMS (TEL-1).

Directory.CreateDirectory for {BaseDir}\Logs runs outside any try (Logger.cs:28-31). On an IIS site where Logs is missing and the app pool cannot create it, every Logger.SAP call throws, including the one inside the OrderController catch (OC:45), so the decided 200 'Error, ...' (R4) becomes a 500. The same throw from the OM:610 or OM:671 catches turns an order whose header is already written into an error.

LinkMagentoAccountAsync builds the CSRF and PATCH URLs without sap-client=110 (:842-843). Every other call in the file sends it (e.g. :30, :76). If the gateway's default client is not 110, getSms with cliente > 0 returns -1 and no SMS is queued (CreditMethods.cs:322-326).

The callback HttpClient uses a handler that accepts any TLS certificate (OM:1200-1201, passed at :1208). LAN created the same handler but never passed it to HttpClient, so LAN validated certificates. With T1b on, the DMZ credentials would go to an endpoint with an invalid certificate.

SendSmsNewNumberAsync builds the INSERT into TcAAEA00030_EnvioMensajes with string.Format and request.Cliente unescaped. This is SQL injection on ServicioAndroid for any authenticated caller. It does not affect business parity.

FechaSap turns '/Date(-62135596800000)/' into 0001-01-01 instead of treating it as empty, which bypasses the Q11 default of 1900-01-02 (G2-40). The BP05MA format for an empty Birthdt has not been captured.

The commented liberador block is not a usable template. It uses idClienteMagento, which was removed (:680), has await inside non-async lambdas (:690, :700), compares uen with ToUpper()=='VIU' (:682) while the header uses 'viu' (:744), and sits after the lines try/catch, so it would fire even when the lines failed. LAN does not.

The credit gate puts the raw infoCliente.cuenta into the ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE $filter (:30) and the BP05MA key (:302) without escaping or URL encoding. getSms has a regex guard (CreditMethods.cs:338); order/new does not. No row impact today, since BP05MA would fail; it is an injection hygiene issue.

The SD29 sales organization matches 'viu' case-insensitively with contains (OM:347), while the header uen and sucursal use an exact 'viu' (OM:744). With storeId 'VIU', the header gets MA (uen 1, sucursal 504) while the lines are priced for VIU (05).
The XML remarks of InsertCreditArticlesAsync (OM:803-810) still describe the old SKU-only SD29 lookup; since E5 the code uses Articulo+OrgVtas+Condicion (OM:986-1008).

bugs.scenario: The service is deployed where {BaseDir}\Logs does not exist and the app-pool identity cannot create it. A credit order with an unknown BP throws 'sin cuenta', the controller catch calls Logger.SAP, and CreateDirectory throws UnauthorizedAccessException. The response is 500 instead of 200 'Error, Error en SetOrder: sin cuenta'. Magento still treats it as accepted (MCO:53), but the DMZ and support see a different contract.

bugs.summary: The account gate puts infoCliente.cuenta, raw and untrimmed, into the OData $filter (BPM:30) and the BP05MA key predicate (BPM:302). The apostrophe is not doubled and the URL is not encoded. E5 fixed this pattern for SKUs (FinalListProperMethods); the BP lookups still have it. LAN used SQL parameters.
bugs.scenario: A cuenta containing an apostrophe, '&' or '#' gives a malformed or truncated URL. SAP returns an error and the order ends in 'sin cuenta' with no row, which matches LAN's 'not found'. A crafted value such as x' or BusinessPartner ne 'y can pass the ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE gate, but BP05MA then fails, so no row is written. The business impact is nil today; it is a robustness and injection hygiene issue. A cuenta with a trailing space would match in LAN, because SQL Server ignores trailing spaces in '='. How SAP behaves for the same value: NO EVIDENCE.

groups.summary:
G1 Elegibilidad has 25 rules: the 24 original rules plus G1-25 (NUEVA 2026-09-29). None of the 11 NUEVA 2026-09-30 rules belongs to G1. I checked each one against the working copy: branch SpExportaEcommerce, HEAD 2cf425f plus the uncommitted 2026-10-01 12:12 changes (4 files, +109/-64; OM has 3347 lines). I also checked LAN, the SPs, the DMZ and Magento248.

**Parity:** 5 EQUAL, 7 EQUAL_SAP_SOURCE, 3 DECIDED_DIFFERENT, 5 PENDING_DECISION, 1 MISSING, 3 NOT_APPLICABLE, 1 BLOCKED_OTHER_TEAM, 0 DIFFERENT.
- 15 of 25 rules behave like LAN or differ only by a user decision (R4, R5, R7, Q11, DU2, DU6, DU15).
- 3 rules do not apply.
- 7 are open: the five no-row gates (P1), the reprocess tool G1-04 (P11) and the liberador G1-22 (DU11).

**Who gets a request already matches LAN:**
- Only an existing BP gets a row.
- An empty cuenta, an unknown BP or an SAP error ends in 'sin cuenta' before the only INSERT (OM:644-646). The guide is still saved, as in LAN.
- There is no balance, NIP, term or total check, and no client is created.
- A condition with no equivalent continues as in LAN (DU15).

**Ready to test:**
- Yes for direct POST order/new tests (V2 positive with an existing BP, V3 N1-N3 'sin cuenta').
- The share DLL was rebuilt on 2026-10-02 10:15, after the last source change. Which instance runs it: NO EVIDENCE.
- No credit test has been run: Logs/sap.log ends on 2026-09-17 and has no credit entries.

**Not ready:**
- The expected results for the P1 gate cases are undecided (empty articulos, null codigoPostal or names, short phone, null keys).
- E2E through Magento (V4) cannot work yet. OrderManagement.php:719 still sends getCuentaIntelisis(), so every real order ends in 'sin cuenta' with no row, while Magento shows PROCESANDO and clears the cart.
- The liberador and callback wait for the other team.

**Vault accuracy:**
- Business Rules Ecommerce describes the current G1 code correctly, with current line numbers. Its only gap is that it does not mark validateCredit as deprecated.
- MATRIZ, CREDITO_WEB_ANALISIS and ACTIVIDADES are stale on several points:
  - they still describe the removed [CREDITO SIN CUENTA] log;
  - they still say G1-14 validates the condition and is blocked by P2 (DU15 closed P2);
  - the line numbers and the diff baseline are out of date (+161/-64 documented, +109/-64 today);
  - the binary date is out of date.

**Real bugs (both low):**
- Logger.cs:27-31 can turn the controller's 200 error reply into a 500.
- The cuenta goes into the OData filter and the BP05MA key without escaping (BPM:30, :302). Today this has no row impact.

groups.summary:
G2 Cabecera parity, checked against the working copy (branch SpExportaEcommerce, HEAD 2cf425f plus uncommitted changes of 2026-10-01 12:12; git diff = 4 files, +109/−64). Result for 40 rules: 20 EQUAL, 11 EQUAL_SAP_SOURCE, 4 DECIDED_DIFFERENT (G2-03 DIMAS MX, G2-10 Q11 date default, G2-38/G2-39 response body by R4), 4 PENDING_DECISION (G2-16 codigoPostal null, G2-23 empty articulos, G2-29 short phone, G2-40 Birthdt sentinel), 1 NOT_APPLICABLE. Nothing is DIFFERENT, MISSING or blocked by another team. Counting user decisions as closed, that is 36 of 40 (90 %); ACTIVIDADES reports 75 % because it counts confirmations and cleanups as open.

What I verified directly:
- The header INSERT text is identical to SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS. I normalized both and diffed them token by token: SCW:35-157 against SPD:223-344, 59 columns and 59 values, GETDATE, literal 1 and ISNULL.
- All 57 parameter types and widths match the SP; only @cliente differs (10 instead of 9, as decided).
- Every value in CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync (OM:741-797) and ArmarFila (SCW:232-308) matches LAN ProductosCreditoWeb_SaveData (LCM:94-262), getClientInfo (LCM:804-868) and SetPedido (LOM:609-649) for an existing BP and a normal Magento payload.
- DU12, DU13, DU15 and DU18 are applied in the code.

The vault: Business Rules Ecommerce describes the current header code correctly, with exact line numbers. Its only flaws are an overgeneralized RCRE-21, the missing explicit-null edge cases, and the empty-articulos gate left out of its pending list. MATRIZ, CAMBIOS §4.2 and CREDITO_WEB_ANALISIS §3.2 and §6 are stale for nombre/Namemiddle (DU13), uppercase (DU12), Marst (DU18), Q5 (DU15) and DIMAS MX. Their line citations and the diff baselines (+126/−44 and +161/−64) no longer match the code. The R4 spec in CREDITO_WEB_ANALISIS §6.2.1 would undo DU13. No real code bug was found in G2. One latent risk is unconfirmed: FechaSap would turn '/Date(-62135596800000)/' into 0001-01-01 (G2-40).

Ready to test? Yes for the positive header test (V2) with an existing BP posted directly to order/new. Preconditions:
1. Confirm the binary on the test instance. A Debug build dated 2026-10-02 10:15 now sits in the share's bin and obj, newer than the code; whether it is deployed is NO EVIDENCE.
2. The user checks the INSERT permission of the MAVICBOSANDROID login (V2 step 0).
3. Use a numeric test BP. Magento still sends the Intelisis account (MOM:719), so real Magento orders end in 'sin cuenta'.
4. Fix the V2 expected values (ACT-04): nombre must include Namemiddle.
5. Capture BP05MA for a BP with two given names and for one without Birthdt (ACT-18).

There is no credit test evidence yet: Logs/sap.log ends on 2026-09-17 and contains no credit order. The negative tests (V3) for G2-16, G2-23 and G2-29 cannot be asserted until P1 is answered (ACT-12).

groups.summary:
Verdict for G3 (phone validation) plus the NIP SMS routes: the business logic is mostly at parity. The phone-validation part of order/new can be component-tested against ServicioSAP directly once the prerequisites below are done. It cannot be tested end-to-end through Magento.

Parity, checked against the working copy (HEAD 2cf425f plus uncommitted edits of 2026-10-01 12:12, 4 files, +109/−64), across 23 vault G3 rules and 8 NIP route rules:
- **G3 (23 rules):** 8 EQUAL, 3 EQUAL_SAP_SOURCE (DU2-DU4), 2 DECIDED_DIFFERENT (R4/09-26, DU4), 2 NOT_APPLICABLE, 5 PENDING_DECISION (P1, P16 ×2, R2-b, G3-23 format), 2 DIFFERENT, 1 BLOCKED_OTHER_TEAM (DMZ). That is 15 of 23 closed (65 %), against ACTIVIDADES' 12 of 23 (52 %). The gap comes from G3-16 being covered by R4, G3-18 giving the same value under DU2, and G3-19 already behaving like the SP in code.
- **The 2 DIFFERENT rules (G3-04, G3-08)** are the same small fix, R1: OM:626 Trim and OM:651 IsNullOrWhiteSpace. It is LISTO in the plan but not applied, and only matters for values with spaces.
- **Code that matches LAN:** the three-valued IF, the prospect branch, the SMS lookups, the AWS origin catalog and the VARCHAR(10) cuts.
- **getSms / validateSms:** same decision tree, SQL, tables and return codes as LAN. Still open:
  - the ZidMagento PATCH-failure decision (Q9), plus the missing sap-client bug (BPM:842-843);
  - the DMZ still routes both routes to LAN (DMZ CreditController.cs:76, :107);
  - the LAN checkout gate credit/GetPhoneValidatedClientSecretName is not ported and is not tracked in any vault rule.

Business Rules Ecommerce describes the current G3 code correctly, with one exception: it overstates what A_GET_TelefonoValidado returns. The API returns only the latest phone of any type, and undated phones win.

The stale documents are MATRIZ, DOC and ACTIVIDADES:
- log notes for G3-03 and G3-12;
- the line citations and the +161/−64 baseline;
- the bin DLL date: the share DLL is now 2026-10-02 10:15, built from unknown sources.

Readiness. There is no evidence of any run: Logs/sap.log was last written 2026-09-17 and has no credit or SMS entries. Before a meaningful test:

bugs.summary: GetCondicionAsync returns SIGMavi CondicionesCredVtaLinea.Condicion as the SD29 condition code without any check. If that column holds the Magento text or the Propre description, as in LAN's VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea (the Magento text is in Condicion, SPL:261), no product line can ever be priced. Supporting hint: GetPlazosAsync (Methods/Credit/CreditMethods.cs:28-31, :44-45) reads CondicionPropre from the same table and still has to translate it through PaymentConditionCatalog.
bugs.scenario: Order '12 M MA P INM' with storeId muebles_america. Suppose SIGMavi returns Condicion = '12 M MA P INM' (not '12IA'). Then condicionSap is non-empty, so the catalog is never used (OM:3336). The SD29 filter Condicion eq '12 M MA P INM' finds no e-commerce rows; the retry with the Magento text is skipped because it is the same text (OM:993-994); the code finds no matching row (OM:930-935). Every product line is skipped with an Orden gap, only SEGU00001 is written, and the response is 'Concluido'. The only trace is Console output (OM:924, :961, :983), which IIS does not keep, so nothing reaches sap.log.

bugs.summary: The XML remarks of InsertCreditArticlesAsync (OM:803-810) still describe the old SD29 lookup (GetFinalListProperBySkuAsync with $filter=Articulo only). Since E5 the code uses Articulo + OrgVtas + Condicion through ObtenerPreciosCreditoAsync (OM:986-1008). Tracked as ACT-17(e).
bugs.scenario: A reviewer in the ACT-26 diff review, or the S1/S2 Fable session, trusts the comment and checks the wrong behavior or 'fixes' code that is already right.

bugs.summary: Two storeId comparisons disagree. The SD29 sales organization uses a case-insensitive 'contains viu' (OM:347). The header uen and sucursal use an exact 'viu' (OM:744). This is not a LAN-parity defect, since LAN had no OrgVtas filter on price (SPL:258-262). It is an internal inconsistency that Business Rules already lists under 'Sin actividad registrada'.
bugs.scenario: With storeId 'VIU', the header gets uen 1 and sucursal 504 (MA) while the lines are priced with OrgVtas 05 (VIU). Magento sends lowercase 'viu' today, so this has not been observed.

G5 (post-creation) has 32 rules: 27 from the MATRIZ plus 5 'NUEVA 2026-09-30' in CREDITO_WEB_ANALISIS §3. I re-checked each against the working copy (branch SpExportaEcommerce, HEAD 2cf425f plus uncommitted changes from 2026-10-01 12:12) and against LAN, the DMZ (09cb341) and Magento248, read-only.

**Parity (newest decision layer applied: DU16 coupon removed, DU17 logs, R4 contract, R5 guide, R7 no staging, DU11/DU20 waits):**
- **Closed: 17 of 32 (53 %).** EQUAL 4 (G5-05, G5-13, G5-26, G5-31), EQUAL_SAP_SOURCE 1 (G5-01), DECIDED_DIFFERENT 8 (G5-04, G5-06, G5-07, G5-08, G5-14, G5-16, G5-20, G5-27), NOT_APPLICABLE 4 (G5-15, G5-21, G5-22, G5-23).

  - PENDING_DECISION 4: G5-03 and G5-32 (P11/P13), G5-17 (P1), G5-25 (P12).
  - DIFFERENT 2: G5-11 and G5-12, callback body and transport. Fix T1a is ready and does not depend on anyone.

- ACTIVIDADES reports 9 of 32 closed (28 %). The gap is mostly because the vault rule tables never applied DU16 and DU17. Coupon rules G5-06/07/08/27 and the log rule G5-20 are closed in code; Business Rules Ecommerce describes them correctly.

**Ready to test G5? Only partly.**
- **Testable now with a direct POST order/new and a real BP (V2/V3):**
  - G5-13: no SAP document is created.
  - G5-14/G5-16: 200 with the object, or 'Error, ...'.
  - G5-04/G5-05: guide is saved and read back.
  - G5-01: the SD36 check does not block.
  - G5-06/07/08/27: VentasCupones does not change.
  - G5-20: sap.log shows only the expected labels.
  - G5-02: a resend creates a second solicitation. This is the known gap; record it, do not count it as a failure.
- **Not testable:**

  - Any Magento end-to-end run. Magento only polls rows in EN_ANALISIS (PollCreditStatus.php:69-74), and only the callback moves a row there (CreditoOrderManagement.php:135-149). With the callback off, every credit order stays PENDIENTE.

**Bugs:**
- Logger.cs:28 (B8): CreateDirectory runs outside the try, so a log call can throw and turn the decided 200 into a 500.
- Latent, until the liberador is switched on:
  - The callback sends snake_case keys (OrderMethods.cs:1234). The DMZ and Magento would reject the call and the order would stay PENDIENTE.
  - The callback accepts any TLS certificate (:1200). LAN created that handler but never used it.
  - The commented liberador block (:677-711) does not compile and sits after the lines try/catch. Uncommented as is, it would fire even when the lines failed.

**Vault mismatches:**
- DOC §3 and MATRIZ have not absorbed DU16 and DU17.
- ACTIVIDADES' diff baseline (+161/-64) and its OrderMethods line references are stale; the current diff is +109/-64.
- The binary date given in ACTIVIDADES is outdated.
- Business Rules leaves out two things: getGuide reads a different data.db than LAN, and the DMZ already logs request and response.
- Business Rules otherwise matches the code for G5.
